drhp.business: SKP Bearing Industries manufactures industrial bearing components — needle rollers, cylindrical rollers, industrial steel balls, precision pins and satellite balls — serving automotive, engineering and industrial applications. The company operates manufacturing facilities in India and a customer-servicing facility in France, and also holds renewable-energy assets (wind, solar and PM-KUSUM solar) that supply part of its own power requirement.

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Demand for precision bearings continues to be supported by domestic capital-expenditure activity, the government's emphasis on manufacturing and infrastructure, and the ongoing shift towards import substitution in engineering components.
- Opportunities: growing domestic demand for precision bearings, import-substitution tailwinds, IATF 16949 quality certification enabling cross-sell into automotive and industrial customers, and captive renewable-energy generation supporting cost competitiveness.
- Threats: volatility in raw-material (steel) prices, foreign-exchange fluctuation affecting the …

capex_expansion.body: Plant III at Surendranagar was developed as a dedicated steel ball manufacturing facility during FY2025-26, supporting future manufacturing expansion and product portfolio diversification; this was a key driver of the year's capacity additions. Manufacturing facilities in India are located at Wadhwan, Lakhtar and Surendranagar, alongside the France subsidiary's La Talaudière facility supporting European customer servicing.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- distribution: In-region customer servicing in Europe via the France facility shortens response cycles for European customers — evidence: "The La Talaudière facility supports customer coordination, export servicing activities, and regional industrial engagement across European markets" — against it: the France subsidiary recorded a net loss after tax of approximately ₹1,379.36 Lakhs during the year.
- cost position: Captive renewable-energy generation (wind, solar, PM-KUSUM) supplies part of manufacturing power requirement, supporting cost competitiveness — evidence: MD&A states renewable-energy …

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The most significant concern during the year was the loss recorded by the France subsidiary and the associated foreign-currency exposure; management is reviewing the subsidiary's operations to improve performance.
- Company flags volatility in raw-material (steel) prices as a threat under MD&A Opportunities and Threats.
- Company operates in a market with established domestic and imported bearing-brand competition, flagged as a threat.
- The performance risk associated with the overseas (France) subsidiary is separately flagged as a threat, distinct from the FX exposure risk.
- The Company is exposed to market, credit, operational and foreign-exchange risks per the MD&A Risks and Concerns section, mitigated through a risk-management framework, credit controls and preventive maintenance of plant and machinery.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Manufacturing expansion, market diversification, operational efficiency, and sustainable business development.
- Cross-sell into automotive and industrial customers using IATF 16949 quality certification.
- Reduce risk exposure through continuous monitoring of the France subsidiary's operations, with management reviewing the subsidiary with a view to improving its performance.
